fields.name: HW Addr Length
fields.desc: Length of a hardware address. Ethernet = 6.

fields.name: Proto Addr Length
fields.desc: Length of a protocol address. IPv4 = 4.

fields.name: Operation
fields.desc: 3 = RARP request, 4 = RARP reply. ARP uses 1 and 2.

fields.name: Sender HW Addr
fields.desc: MAC of the sender. In a request, the client's own MAC.

fields.name: Sender Proto Addr
fields.desc: IP of the sender. Undefined in a request — the client doesn't know it yet.

fields.name: Target HW Addr
fields.desc: The MAC being looked up. The client puts its own MAC here too.

fields.name: Target Proto Addr
fields.desc: The answer. Filled in by the server with the client's IP.
